# Run embryo GO enrichment using session objects
GO.terms.raw <- Annot[, c(2, 13)]
splitted_go  <- strsplit(as.character(GO.terms.raw$Gene_ontology_IDs), ";")
GO.terms.bp  <- data.frame(v1 = rep.int(GO.terms.raw$Gene, sapply(splitted_go, length)),
                            v2 = unlist(splitted_go))
GO.terms.bp$v2 <- gsub(" GO:", "GO:", GO.terms.bp$v2)

ID.vector     <- calc.lengths$Gene
LENGTH.vector <- calc.lengths$length

DEG.emb.vec <- as.integer(ID.vector %in% as.character(up.EMB.sig.list$Gene))
names(DEG.emb.vec) <- ID.vector
DEG.pwf.emb <- nullp(DEG.emb.vec, ID.vector, bias.data = LENGTH.vector, plot.fit = FALSE)
GO.wall.emb <- goseq(DEG.pwf.emb, ID.vector, gene2cat = GO.terms.bp,
                     test.cats = c("GO:CC","GO:BP","GO:MF"),
                     method = "Wallenius", use_genes_without_cat = TRUE)

bp_emb <- GO.wall.emb |>
  dplyr::mutate(padj       = p.adjust(over_represented_pvalue, method = "BH"),
                stage      = "Embryo_28",
                gene_ratio = numDEInCat / numInCat) |>
  dplyr::filter(padj < 0.01, ontology == "BP")

cat("bp_lar BP terms:", nrow(bp_lar), "\n")
cat("bp_emb BP terms:", nrow(bp_emb), "\n")
